description: Full version control for all orchestration configuration — session configs, org charts, budget presets, skill assignments, and policy rules. Every config change is snapshotted and rollbackable. Paperclip has basic config versioning — XRoads does it with git-native diffing and branch-level granularity.
goals: Every config change creates an immutable snapshot
Rollback to any previous config version instantly
Config inheritance: workspace defaults → session overrides → slot overrides
Config as code: export/import as YAML/JSON, version in git

ConfigSnapshot.description: An immutable snapshot of configuration state

fields.sessionId: UUID? FK CockpitSession — null for workspace-level configs
fields.configType: ConfigType enum — session, org_chart, budget, policy, skill_map, full
fields.data: String — JSON blob of the full config at this version
fields.diff: String? — JSON diff from previous version
fields.changeReason: String? — human-readable description of what changed

user_stories.title: ConfigSnapshot entity + DB migration + snapshot engine
user_stories.description: Migration v14: config_snapshot table. Auto-incrementing version per (sessionId, configType) combo. Snapshot engine: on any config change, auto-create snapshot. Config sources to snapshot: 1) Session config (status, chairman brief, slot assignments). 2) Org chart (all OrgRole records serialized). 3) Budget config (all BudgetConfig records). 4) Policy rules (SafeExecutor overrides). 5) Skill map (slot → skill assignments). 6) Runtime map (slot → agent runtime assignments). 7) Full snapshot (all of the above in one blob). Diff computation: JSON diff between current and previous version (add/remove/change fields). Repo: create_snapshot, list_versions, get_snapshot, get_diff, get_latest.

user_stories.title: Rollback engine
user_stories.description: Restore configuration to any previous snapshot version. Rollback flow: 1) Load target snapshot data. 2) Parse JSON into config objects. 3) Apply: update session, recreate org roles, update budget configs, update policy overrides, update skill assignments. 4) Create NEW snapshot with changeReason 'Rollback to v{N}'. 5) Emit config-rollback event for UI. Rollback safety: before rollback, create a snapshot of CURRENT state (so you can undo the undo). Rollback scope: can rollback individual config types (just budget, just org chart) or full. Never delete snapshots — history is immutable.

user_stories.title: Config inheritance chain
user_stories.description: Three-level config inheritance: Workspace defaults → Session overrides → Slot overrides. Resolution: for any config key, check slot-level first, then session-level, then workspace-level, then global defaults. Example: budget — workspace default is $25, session override is $50, slot 0 override is $10. Slot 0 gets $10, other slots get $50. Inheritance tracked in snapshots: each snapshot records which level it represents. UI shows inheritance visually: grayed-out values = inherited, solid values = explicitly set. 'Reset to inherited' button clears override.
tests: slot override takes precedence over session
session override takes precedence over workspace
reset clears override and inherits parent
inheritance chain visible in snapshot data

user_stories.title: Config as code (export/import)
user_stories.description:
Export config to .crossroads/config.yaml (human-readable). Import config from file. Format: YAML with sections for each config type. Example:
```yaml
xroads:
  org_chart:
    template: squad
    roles: [...]
  budget:
    preset: standard
    session_cap: 2500
  policy:
    auto_approve_low: true
  skills:
    slot_0: [backend, testing]
```
Export: Tauri command that serializes current config to YAML file. Import: parse YAML, validate against schema, apply as new config (creating snapshot). Git-trackable: user can commit .crossroads/config.yaml to their repo. On session start, auto-load config.yaml if present.

user_stories.title: Config history UI + diff viewer
user_stories.description: UI components: 1) Config history timeline — vertical list of snapshots with version number, timestamp, changed_by, change_reason, config_type badge. 2) Diff viewer — side-by-side JSON diff between any two versions (green=added, red=removed, yellow=changed). 3) Rollback button per version with confirmation dialog. 4) Config inspector — current effective config with inheritance indicators. 5) Compare button — select two versions to diff. 6) Export/import buttons in settings. Accessible from cockpit panel as 'Config' tab.
